# Daniel Mauricio Flores

> Senior software engineer building AI systems, voice AI, agentic platforms, backend services and cloud infrastructure.

## About

Daniel Mauricio Flores is a tech-stack agnostic generalist with 12+ years of industry experience and a product-oriented, innovative, systems-thinking mindset. He is based in Paris, France.

## Experience

- **ROUNDED**: Senior Software Engineer working end-to-end across voice AI solutions, agentic systems, backend platforms and cloud infrastructure, from architecture through deployment, scaling and operations.
- **CRITEO**: Software Engineer II who developed dashboards, analytics tools and AI-powered applications that helped advertisers make data-driven decisions.
- **IBM**: Software Engineer who developed AI-powered chatbots, SAP mobile and web applications, dashboards and received a global IBM award for technical volunteering work.

## Topics

AI systems, voice AI, agentic systems, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, full-stack development, developer platforms, observability and product engineering.
